column1: # The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild on Android (base v0 + update 1.9.0 = v1114112, DLC Master Trials)
# Tested 2026-11-11 on the Red Magic Astra NP05J (Snapdragon 8 Elite, Adreno 830, Android 16), Qualcomm's driver 512.800: the boot, the logos, the opening
# to the Shrine of Resurrection, about 2.5 minutes a run, no device lost. Docked (the game's 1600x900 into 1920x1080): 20 fps, replay 37 ms, GPU 35 ms a frame.
# With Tears of the Kingdom's settings (handheld, DM_VK_FDZ=0, DM_NVN_ASYNC=1, DM_PIN_REPLAY=prime): the opening cutscene 20 -> 30 fps (replay 14, GPU 12 ms);
# the shrine with Link controllable (3,300-3,600 draws) still 20 fps: replay 18, GPU 15.6 ms, frame 50 ms. DM_VK_MT_REPLAY=1 made it worse (replay 22-25 ms),
# DM_RENDER_SCALE=0.75 left the GPU time as it was (draw-bound, not pixel-bound).
# porter port --vulkan-driver with Turnip Gen8 V39 Patched (StevenMXZ/freedreno_turnip-CI, Mesa 27.0.0-devel, 2026-11-07): the shrine at 30 fps (3,100-4,700
# draws: replay 14-17 ms, GPU 12-15 ms, frame p50 33 ms; Qualcomm's 18-24 / 16-20 / 48-50), 8 of 10 windows of 300 frames held, the rest loading; picture correct, SoC 43 °C.
